name: date_bin_null_strides
query: SELECT DISTINCT date_bin('-7 days', 2015-03-30, 2015-01-05) AS negative_days, date_bin(interval('2 fortnights'), 2015-03-30, 2015-01-05) AS unknown_unit, date_bin('-1 year', 2015-03-30, 2015-01-05) AS negative_year WHERE account = 'Expenses:Financial:Fees'
notes: A negative stride is NULL, and so is a NULL stride (interval('2 fortnights') is NULL). (beanquery rejects a NULL literal argument at compile time, since NULL has its own type there; zhang returns NULL.)
